metrics.label: Population
metrics.method: The ACS estimate counts residents at this place during the 2020–2024 survey period. It is a population count, not a population density or growth rate.

metrics.label: Median age
metrics.method: The ACS estimates the age at the midpoint of the population at this place during 2020–2024. Half the population is younger than this age and half is older.

metrics.label: Men per 100 women
metrics.method: Men divided by women, multiplied by 100. Values below 100 mean fewer men than women.

metrics.label: Hispanic or Latino share
metrics.method: Hispanic or Latino residents divided by all residents, multiplied by 100. This is the share of the total population that is Hispanic or Latino; Hispanic origin can be of any race.

metrics.label: Foreign-born share
metrics.method: Residents born outside the United States divided by all residents, multiplied by 100. This is the share of the population that is foreign-born.

metrics.label: Share of foreign-born residents born in Latin America
metrics.method: Residents born in Latin America divided by foreign-born residents, multiplied by 100. This is the share of foreign-born residents born in Latin America.

metrics.label: Share of residents who are not U.S. citizens
metrics.method: Non-citizen residents divided by total residents, multiplied by 100.

metrics.label: Share of foreign-born residents who arrived in 2010 or later
metrics.method: Foreign-born residents who arrived in 2010 or later divided by all foreign-born residents, multiplied by 100. This is the share of foreign-born residents who arrived during that period.

metrics.label: Median household income
metrics.method: The ACS estimates the midpoint of household incomes at this place over 2020–2024: half of households had a higher income and half had a lower income. This is a household measure, not income per person.

metrics.label: Average income per person
metrics.method: Total income in the past 12 months divided by the total population. This is the average dollar income per person, not a household income figure.

metrics.label: Median monthly rent
metrics.method: The ACS estimates the midpoint of monthly gross rents for renter-occupied homes paying cash rent. Half of these rents are higher and half are lower.

metrics.label: Median home value
metrics.method: The ACS estimates the midpoint of reported home values for owner-occupied homes. Half of the estimated values are higher and half are lower.

metrics.label: Median monthly owner costs
metrics.method: The ACS estimates selected monthly costs for owner-occupied homes, including housing expenses such as mortgage payments, taxes, insurance, utilities, and fuels. This is a housing-cost measure, not a home price.

metrics.label: Share of renters spending 30%+ of income on rent
metrics.method: Renters spending 30 percent or more of household income on rent divided by renter households with a computable ratio, multiplied by 100.

metrics.label: Homeownership rate
metrics.method: Owner-occupied households divided by owner- and renter-occupied households, multiplied by 100.

metrics.label: Poverty rate
metrics.method: People whose income is below the Census poverty threshold divided by the population for whom poverty status is determined, multiplied by 100. It is the share of that population below the threshold; it is not a measure of how far below it their incomes are.

metrics.label: Share of households earning $200,000+
metrics.method: Households with income of $200,000 or more divided by all households, multiplied by 100.

metrics.label: Cost of living index
metrics.method: BEA Regional Price Parities. The US value is 100; values above 100 indicate a higher price level. State observations only; no county value is inferred.

metrics.label: Bachelor's degree rate
metrics.method: Adults 25+ with a bachelor's degree divided by adults 25+, multiplied by 100.

metrics.label: Master's degree rate
metrics.method: Adults 25+ with a master's degree divided by adults 25+, multiplied by 100.

metrics.label: Doctorate rate
metrics.method: Adults 25+ with a doctorate divided by adults 25+, multiplied by 100.

metrics.label: High school attainment rate
metrics.method: Adults 25+ with a high school diploma or higher divided by adults 25+, multiplied by 100.

metrics.label: No diploma rate
metrics.method: Adults 25+ without a high school diploma divided by adults 25+, multiplied by 100.

metrics.label: Unemployment rate
metrics.method: Unemployed people divided by the civilian labor force, multiplied by 100. The labor force includes employed people and unemployed people who are available for work and actively looking, or on temporary layoff. This is a share of the labor force, not of all residents.

metrics.label: Share of workers working from home
metrics.method: Workers age 16 and older who worked from home divided by all workers age 16 and older, multiplied by 100. It is the share of workers whose commute mode was working from home.

metrics.label: Murders
metrics.source: FBI Crime Data Explorer + Census ACS 2024 5-year
metrics.method: Custom crude rate: 2023 FBI Crime Data Explorer count divided by the 2020–2024 ACS 5-year total population estimate, multiplied by 100,000. The US value uses the source national count and ACS estimate; no county or annual FBI rate is inferred.

metrics.label: Violent crime
metrics.source: FBI Crime Data Explorer + Census ACS 2024 5-year
metrics.method: Custom crude rate: 2023 FBI Crime Data Explorer count divided by the 2020–2024 ACS 5-year total population estimate, multiplied by 100,000. The US value uses the source national count and ACS estimate; no county or annual FBI rate is inferred.

metrics.label: Robbery
metrics.source: FBI Crime Data Explorer + Census ACS 2024 5-year
metrics.method: Custom crude rate: 2023 FBI Crime Data Explorer count divided by the 2020–2024 ACS 5-year total population estimate, multiplied by 100,000. The US value uses the source national count and ACS estimate; no county or annual FBI rate is inferred.

metrics.label: Aggravated assault
metrics.source: FBI Crime Data Explorer + Census ACS 2024 5-year
metrics.method: Custom crude rate: 2023 FBI Crime Data Explorer count divided by the 2020–2024 ACS 5-year total population estimate, multiplied by 100,000. The US value uses the source national count and ACS estimate; no county or annual FBI rate is inferred.

metrics.label: Burglary
metrics.source: FBI Crime Data Explorer + Census ACS 2024 5-year
metrics.method: Custom crude rate: 2023 FBI Crime Data Explorer count divided by the 2020–2024 ACS 5-year total population estimate, multiplied by 100,000. The US value uses the source national count and ACS estimate; no county or annual FBI rate is inferred.

metrics.label: Motor vehicle theft
metrics.source: FBI Crime Data Explorer + Census ACS 2024 5-year
metrics.method: Custom crude rate: 2023 FBI Crime Data Explorer count divided by the 2020–2024 ACS 5-year total population estimate, multiplied by 100,000. The US value uses the source national count and ACS estimate; no county or annual FBI rate is inferred.

metrics.label: Rape
metrics.source: FBI Crime Data Explorer + Census ACS 2024 5-year
metrics.method: Custom crude rate: 2023 FBI Crime Data Explorer count divided by the 2020–2024 ACS 5-year total population estimate, multiplied by 100,000. The US value uses the source national count and ACS estimate; no county or annual FBI rate is inferred.

metrics.label: Obesity rate
metrics.method: CDC PLACES county estimate for 2023. County observations only; state and national values are not inferred.

metrics.label: Diabetes rate
metrics.method: CDC PLACES county estimate for 2023. County observations only; state and national values are not inferred.

metrics.label: Physical inactivity rate
metrics.method: CDC PLACES county estimate for 2023. County observations only; state and national values are not inferred.

metrics.label: Income before deductions
metrics.method: Income before deductions from IRS Statistics of Income, multiplied by 1,000. State values are sums of county income; the US value is the sum of county income. The per-resident variant divides 2023 income by 2023 annual PEP population.
metrics.sourceRelease: IRS SOI County 2023; Census PEP Vintage 2025

metrics.label: Average electricity price
metrics.method: EIA state average electricity price for all sectors. State observations only; no county value is inferred.

metrics.label: Recreation and fitness facilities per 1,000 residents
metrics.method: USDA Food Environment Atlas published 2023 rate. County observations only; no state or national value is inferred.

metrics.label: New cancer cases per 100,000 residents
metrics.formula: 2023 incident cases / 2023 annual PEP total population * 100000
metrics.method: Custom crude incidence rate: 2023 incident cancer cases divided by matching 2023 annual Census PEP total population, multiplied by 100,000. This is not age-adjusted. Suppressed source cells remain missing; no county value is inferred.
metrics.sourceRelease: CDC USCS diagnosis year 2023; Census PEP Vintage 2025

rateMetadata.formula: 2023 incident cases ÷ 2023 annual PEP total population × 100,000 (crude; not age-adjusted)

metrics.label: New HIV diagnoses per 100,000 residents
metrics.formula: 2024 provisional diagnoses age 13+ / 2024 annual PEP age 13+ population * 100000
metrics.method: Custom crude rate: provisional 2024 diagnoses among people age 13 and older divided by matching 2024 annual Census PEP age-13-plus population, multiplied by 100,000. The US value uses the national numerator and denominator; no county value is inferred.
metrics.sourceRelease: CDC AtlasPlus/NHSS 2024 provisional; Census PEP Vintage 2025

rateMetadata.numeratorSource: CDC AtlasPlus/NHSS provisional HIV diagnoses age 13+
rateMetadata.formula: 2024 provisional age-13-plus diagnoses ÷ 2024 annual PEP age-13-plus population × 100,000

metrics.label: Deaths among children under 18 per 100,000 children
metrics.formula: 2024 deaths among ages 0–17 / 2024 annual PEP under-18 population * 100000
metrics.method: Custom crude rate: observed 2024 deaths among people ages 0–17 divided by matching 2024 annual Census PEP under-18 population, multiplied by 100,000. Suppressed source counts remain missing; no county value is inferred.
metrics.sourceRelease: CDC WONDER 2024 final; Census PEP Vintage 2025

rateMetadata.formula: 2024 deaths ages 0–17 ÷ 2024 annual PEP under-18 population × 100,000

library.label: Share of foreign-born residents born in Latin America
library.reason: Loaded and valid, but it is a second birthplace lens; the map keeps one foreign-born indicator.

library.label: Share of foreign-born residents who arrived in 2010 or later
library.reason: Loaded and valid, but it is a second immigration-period lens; the map keeps one citizenship indicator.

library.label: Violent crime, year-over-year change
library.reason: A state trend series needs its own time control; it is not a single-snapshot map layer.

library.label: Capital gains
library.reason: Additive tax totals need return denominators before a rate can be compared.

library.label: Dividends
library.reason: Additive tax totals need return denominators before a rate can be compared.

library.label: Fast-food restaurants per 1,000 residents
library.reason: 2020 vintage would imply current coverage; label the period before promotion.

library.label: Low access to a grocery store
library.reason: Two distinct measures share one catalog field; keep both labels in the library.

library.label: Farmers' markets per 1,000 residents
library.reason: 2018 vintage; label the period before promotion.

library.label: PM2.5
library.reason: Only 1,044 counties have monitoring coverage; not a national map.

library.label: Ozone
library.reason: Only 1,209 counties have monitoring coverage; not a national map.

race-ethnicity.label: White non-Hispanic share
race-ethnicity.method: People who are White alone and not Hispanic or Latino divided by all residents, multiplied by 100. This is the share of the total population in that category.

race-ethnicity.label: Black non-Hispanic share
race-ethnicity.method: People who are Black or African American alone and not Hispanic or Latino divided by all residents, multiplied by 100. This is the share of the total population in that category.

race-ethnicity.label: Asian non-Hispanic share
race-ethnicity.method: People who are Asian alone and not Hispanic or Latino divided by all residents, multiplied by 100. This is the share of the total population in that category.

adjusted-gross-income-agi.label: Income before deductions per resident
adjusted-gross-income-agi.formula: A00100 thousand USD × 1000 / 2023 annual PEP total population
adjusted-gross-income-agi.method: 2023 IRS SOI income in thousand USD multiplied by 1,000, divided by the matching 2023 annual Census PEP total population in persons. This is income per resident, not household income.
adjusted-gross-income-agi.sourceRelease: IRS SOI County 2023; Census PEP Vintage 2025

rateMetadata.numeratorSource: IRS Statistics of Income county income
rateMetadata.formula: A00100 thousand USD × 1,000 ÷ 2023 annual PEP population
